#### combinedPlate (elastodynamics)

Combination of the two boundary treatments on one plate: the bottom edge
(material number 2) is a traction boundary handled by
`ElastodynamicsVectorLBMNeumannValidation`, the remaining edges (material
number 3) are displacement boundaries handled by
`ElastodynamicsVectorLBMDirichletValidation`. Driving force and reference
fields are again taken from the manufactured solution shared by the
elastodynamics cases in `elastodynamics/fields.h`, so the mixed setup can be
validated in the same way as the single boundary ones.

The `run.sh` script performs the same resolution sweep and order of convergence
study as `elastodynamics/vectorLBM/periodicPlate`.
